projectDescription: A Roblox asymmetric horror game built in Luau, featuring playable Killer and Survivor characters, multiple game modes, a custom networking layer (DeltaNetwork), server-side anticheat, moderation commands, and a rich VFX/ability system.
keyFeatures: Asymmetric Killer-vs-Survivors gameplay with multiple distinct playable characters
Four game modes: Classic, Double Trouble, One Bounce, and Powerhouse
Custom DeltaNetwork serialisation layer for low-bandwidth, typed remote events and functions
Server-side anticheat with modular checks (speed-hacking, noclip, flinging, backshotting, flying)
Twelve stackable status effects (Bleed, Burn, Poison, Slowness, Speed, Stunned, Regeneration, etc.)
Rewind-based lag-compensated hitbox system with client-snapshot buffering
ForgeVFX integration for beams, camera shake, shockwaves, particles, and screen effects
Moderation command panel with role-gated admin commands for private and public servers
ProfileStore-backed persistent player data with granular per-player settings
Character skin system with per-skin Config and optional Behavior overrides
Sprint/stamina system configurable per character with per-gamemode modifiers
Terror-radius proximity audio system with layered chase music
publicApiSurface: DeltaNetwork.String / Number / Boolean / Instance / CFrameF24U8 / Vector3F24 / NumberF16 (built-in types)
RoundService gamemodes: Classic, DoubleKiller, OneBounce, Powerhouse
Killer Config fields: Info, Class, SprintConfig, AbilityInfo, ChaseConfig, Animations
Survivor Config fields: Info, SprintConfig, AbilityInfo, PassiveInfo, Animations
Skin Config fields: DisplayName, ActorType, CharacterName, SkinName
Admin commands: BanPlayer, KickPlayer, UnbanPlayer, ForceNextKiller, ForceNextMap, ForceNextGamemode, ForceEndRound, GiveStatus, SetPlayerRole, SpawnCharacter, SendAnnouncement
